setup.title: GD: Work from home vs office
setup.context: Four candidates, one topic, fifteen minutes. Enter the discussion, add a fresh point, build on others and help the group reach a conclusion.
tips: Enter early with one clear point.
Build on someone by name, then add something new.
Invite a quiet voice in, and offer a summary near the end.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Good morning, everyone. Your topic is: should Indian IT companies bring everyone back to the office? You have fifteen minutes. Anyone can begin.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I'll start. Offices are where freshers actually learn — you can't absorb culture on a video call.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I add a different angle? I think the real question is which work needs people in the same room. Mentoring freshers does, but focused coding often doesn't.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I hear you, but I'm not fully convinced — different sounds good on paper, but who checks that it actually works?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Building on what Ananya said about commute time — in Bengaluru that's two hours a day. A hybrid plan with three office days for new joiners could give us both.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Adding to that: Bengaluru matters, but it depends a lot on the team and the city.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Partly agree. But let's not forget the practical side — someone has to make it work day to day.
